extensionDescription.message: Converts recipe quantities to metric, right on the page.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension shown in the add-ons manager.

scaleLabel.description: Label of the scale factor input above a recipe's ingredient list.

scaleReset.description: Button that sets the recipe's scale factor back to 1.

scaleHint.description: Tooltip of the scale factor input, describing what it accepts.

scaleHalve.description: Tooltip of the button that halves the recipe's scale factor.

scaleDouble.description: Tooltip of the button that doubles the recipe's scale factor.

servingsLabel.description: Label of the servings stepper above a recipe's ingredient list.

servingsFewer.description: Tooltip of the button that lowers the number of servings by one.

servingsMore.description: Tooltip of the button that raises the number of servings by one.

popupMetric.description: Popup switch that turns conversion to metric units on or off.

popupAuto.description: Popup switch: when on, every recipe page is converted as it loads; when off, only when asked with the Convert this page button or the context menu.

popupConvertPage.description: Popup button that looks for a recipe on the current tab's page and converts it now.

popupConverted.description: Popup status after Convert this page found the page's recipe.

popupNoRecipe.message: No recipe found on this page.
popupNoRecipe.description: Popup status after Convert this page found no recipe data or no ingredient list it could locate.

popupCannotRun.message: Sous-Chefox can't run on this page.
popupCannotRun.description: Popup status when the current tab is a page extensions can't change, like a Firefox settings page.

popupKitchenUnits.description: Popup switch that writes converted volumes in Finnish kitchen units (decilitres, tablespoons, teaspoons) instead of millilitres.

popupDecimals.message: Decimals instead of fractions (0.5, not ½)
popupDecimals.description: Popup switch that writes scaled and converted amounts as decimals rather than common fractions.

popupDisableSite.description: Popup switch that turns the extension off on the current tab's site, shown with the site's hostname below it.

menuConvertSelection.description: Context menu entry for selected text that converts and scales the selected ingredient lines.
